changes: Nano Banana 2.1 uses OmniaKey synchronous Images endpoints instead of the repeatedly failing media-task worker.
Generation sends JSON; editing sends multipart image or image[] files.
Convert aspect ratio and resolution into explicit pixel size; automatic edits follow the first reference ratio.
Unknown submission outcomes do not automatically create a second paid request.
Transient media polling failures retry the same task ID; failed polling preserves the ID.

limits: Other image models retain their existing media-task transport; their upstream availability has not been repaired by this change.
